_help.HOW TO FILL THIS FILE: Fill in the fields below. Remove this _help block when done.
_help.userid: Their Roblox user ID number (no quotes)
offenses: List offenses as strings in this array
alts: List known alt accounts as strings
_help.description: A description of what they did

evidence.title: Link evidence: give it a title and a url
Text-only evidence: just title and text, no url needed
evidence.text: Write out the evidence as plain text here.

images: Direct image URLs go here as strings. Leave the array empty [] if none.
